title: Public Market details use shared ISR while service availability remains current and authenticated

source.ref: Owner October 8 reliability audit: anonymous detail remains MISS/private-no-store

detail:
Implementation prepared: runtime ISR without force-static or server session reads; fresh opt-in authenticated service availability rechecks product publication and independent booking Space visibility/function gates. Metadata uses the same public eligibility gate. Canonical UUID redirects preserve query strings before cookie stamping and shared-cache lookup. Product, variant, Journey offer, Space privacy/status/storefront and review/comment mutations invalidate affected detail HTML, including ambiguous committed-write/lost-reply outcomes. Existing checkout current-price/stock checks, signed Market attribution and member booking defaults remain. Local behavioral probe, 234 focused tests, full typecheck and source guards passed before clean rebase to main including LIVE-882. OPEN until actual Vercel build artifact and anonymous first/repeat retained-cookie HIT, canonical/malformed URL and private/unpublished gates, plus controlled cache-withdrawal consequences are captured with the exact meaningful-source digest. No production changes or runtime caching success claimed.

RE-TESTED 2026-10-12 (meta scan). The implementation described above never landed: scripts/check-public-market-detail.mjs, the probe this row names, exists on no branch, and app/(public)/market/[id]/page.tsx still reads the session and renders per request. The row is unstarted, not prepared. The 2026-10-12 speed pass only parallelised the page's reads; the shared-ISR work (public eligibility gate, authenticated availability recheck, invalidation on every product, variant, Space and review mutation) is still the whole job.

verify.note: Executes actual shipped public gate, availability, proxy, strict read failures and mutation consequences; exits79 honestly while sanitized runtime evidence is absent. Evidence validation binds source digest, deployment/build ISR, repeat anonymous HIT, aliases, privacy gates and cache withdrawal.
